intro: The NYC Rent Guidelines Board (RGB) sets rent adjustments for the roughly one million apartments subject to the Rent Stabilization Law in New York City.
The Board holds an annual series of public meetings and hearings to consider research from staff and testimony from tenants, owners, advocates, elected officials and experts.
does_title: What NYC Rent Guidelines Board does
does: RGB staff research the economics of the stabilized housing stock and publish reports for the public each year before the Board votes.

name: Red Hook Community Justice Center
title: Red Hook Community Justice Center
desc: Red Hook Community Justice Center, Community court · Red Hook, Brooklyn. The Red Hook Community Justice Center is the nation’s first multi-jurisdictional community court, working to solve neighborhood problems in southwest Brooklyn.
intro: The Red Hook Community Justice Center is the nation’s first multi-jurisdictional community court, working to solve neighborhood problems in southwest Brooklyn.

A single judge hears cases that would otherwise go to three different courts: Civil, Family and Criminal. An independent evaluation found the Justice Center significantly reduced recidivism and jail sentences while increasing public confidence in government.
does_title: What Red Hook Community Justice Center does
does: Beyond the courtroom, the Justice Center runs community restitution, short term psycho-educational groups, long term treatment, and programs that work to improve public safety and trust in justice.

intro: The New York City Council is the city’s legislative body, separate from the Mayor’s administration but an equal partner in how the City is run.
The Council introduces and votes on legislation, negotiates the City’s budget with the Mayor, monitors City agencies, and reviews land use.
does_title: What New York City Council does
does: CB6 is represented by Council Member Shahana Hanif (District 39) and Council Member Alexa Avilés (District 38). The Council can override a mayoral veto with a two thirds vote.
